title: GIRDER DASH 105 Di2 seller post with 8.39 kg claim (2023-03)
publisher: XHS public post; publisher authority unverified
notes: A dealer post (labelled 帝狮) lists a GIRDER DASH disc road bike with carbon frame, fork, seatpost and integrated cockpit, carbon wheels with ceramic bearings, and Shimano 7170 electronic 2×12. It states a complete weight of 8.39 kg without size, pedals or weighing method, and claims an official price of CNY 17,800 while inviting private offers. This is a historical dealer claim, not a verified manufacturer price, checkout or independent measurement.
